works.title: Oracle Framework
works.description: A political and social communication methodology based on 'static-speech' technique that creates fluency in distinguishing genuine group alignment from performative conformity. The user explores how this practice would create emergent equilibria in institutional and street-level contexts, enabling people to recognize and call out false participation in collaborative movements.
works.quote: when talking with people who don't share the greater good... are going to be far more fluent in that communication so even people on the right who try to pretend they're part of the group will stand up by their lack of fluency

works.title: SynthesisGPT Framework
works.description: A multi-expert persona system that synthesizes nuanced advice by combining insights from distinct philosophical perspectives (HonnoldGPT, StoicGPT, LamrimGPT). Each persona represents a specific philosophy or skill set, with structured response generation and user-configurable persona attribution. Being developed as both a conceptual framework and specific instantiations like LamrimGPT.
works.quote: SynthesisGPT is a multi-expert system designed to provide nuanced, multi-faceted advice by synthesizing insights from various personas
